title: HEADLAMP & WINDSHIELD WIPER HOSE ROUTING
summary: Firewall/cowl routing of the headlamp and windshield wiper vacuum hoses: the RH wiper vacuum hose assembly (color-striped white, yellow, green, red hoses) runs from the W/S wiper door vacuum relay and actuator (wiper door actuator) to the wiper control switch grommet, and a metal vacuum pipe assembly runs from the manifold vacuum outlet through check valves along the firewall to the wiper motor area (View A). Hoses and pipe are held by special clips that are bent to retain them; no torques are given. Related sheets: A13, A14.

parts.name: HOSE ASM.-W/S WIPER VAC-R.H.
parts.name_expanded: Hose assembly – windshield wiper vacuum, RH

parts.name: PIPE ASM.

fastening.to: bracket/flange at the upper left of the cowl, above the wiper door vacuum relay
fastening.note: Special clip [2] holds the RH wiper vacuum hose bundle to the vertical bracket; note A: bend clip as required to properly retain hoses.

fastening.note: Special clips [4] hold the vacuum pipe [3] on the firewall: one near the middle of the run, one at the lower right near the check valve and strap, and one in View A near the wiper motor. Note A: bend clip as required to properly retain hoses.
